nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$, $\beta$ and $\gamma$ be natural numbers with $\gamma > 0$ and $\gcd(\alpha, \beta) = 1$. Then there is a natural number $c > 0$ with $\gcd(c, \gamma) = 1$ and $c \equiv \beta \pmod{\alpha}$.
nodes.title: Coprime representatives of a residue class

nodes.summary: Write $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$ for the $n$-th Fermat number. Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $h$ be a natural number and let $k$ be a positive integer such that the sequence $n \mapsto F_{h+n} \bmod p$ is periodic with period $k$ and every positive period of it is a multiple of $k$. Then $p$ divides $F_n$ for some natural number $n$ if and only if $k = 1$.
nodes.title: Prime divisors of Fermat numbers and the period of Fermat residues

nodes.summary: Write $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$. For every natural number $v$ there is a prime $p \equiv 1 \pmod 8$ such that the sequence $n \mapsto F_n \bmod p$ has preperiod exactly $v$: the sequence $n \mapsto F_{v+n} \bmod p$ is periodic with some positive period, and for no $h < v$ is the sequence $n \mapsto F_{h+n} \bmod p$ periodic with a positive period.
nodes.title: Every preperiod of Fermat residues occurs for a prime $p \equiv 1 \pmod 8$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $a$ be a nonzero residue modulo $p$, of multiplicative order $\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$. Then there is a primitive root $g$ modulo $p$ (an element of order $p - 1$ in $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$) with $g^{(p-1)/\operatorname{ord}_p(a)} = a$.
nodes.title: A primitive root in which a residue has index $(p-1)/\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and write $p - 1 = 2^r u$ with $u$ odd. Then there is exactly one pair $(s, t)$ of natural numbers with $s \le r$ and $t \mid u$ such that $g^{2^s t} = 2$ for some primitive root $g$ modulo $p$ (an element of order $p - 1$ in $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$).
nodes.title: Uniqueness of the $2$-adic decomposition of the index of $2$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $g$ be a primitive root modulo $p$ (an element of order $p - 1$ in $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$), let $a \in \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ and let $i$ be a natural number with $g^i = a$. Then $i$ divides $p - 1$ if and only if $i = (p - 1)/\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$, where $\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$ is the multiplicative order of $a$.
nodes.title: Indices dividing $p - 1$

nodes.summary: Write $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$. Let $m$, $i$ and $j$ be natural numbers with $F_i \equiv F_j \pmod m$. Then $F_{i+t} \equiv F_{j+t} \pmod m$ for every natural number $t$.
nodes.title: Congruences between Fermat numbers propagate

nodes.summary: Write $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$. For every positive integer $p$ there are natural numbers $i < j \le p$ with $F_i \equiv F_j \pmod p$.
nodes.title: Two of $F_0, \dots, F_p$ are congruent modulo $p$

nodes.summary: Write $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$. Let $p$ be a prime, and let $h$ and $k$ be the preperiod and the period of $n \mapsto F_n \bmod p$ in the following sense: $k > 0$, the sequence $n \mapsto F_{h+n} \bmod p$ is periodic with period $k$, every positive period of it is a multiple of $k$, and for no $h' < h$ is the sequence $n \mapsto F_{h'+n} \bmod p$ periodic with a positive period. Then for all natural numbers $i < j$,…
nodes.title: Coincidences among Fermat residues

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and write the multiplicative order of $2$ modulo $p$ as $2^v w$ with $v, w$ natural numbers and $w$ odd. Let $k$ be the multiplicative order of $2$ modulo $w$ (so $k = 1$ when $w = 1$), and let $F_m = 2^{2^m} + 1$ be the $m$-th Fermat number. Then the sequence $n \mapsto F_{v+n} \bmod p$ is periodic with period $k$; for every $h < v$, the sequence $n \mapsto F_{h+n} \bmod p$ has no positive…
nodes.title: Preperiod and period of Fermat numbers modulo an odd prime

nodes.summary: Write $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$. Let $p$ be an odd prime, write $p - 1 = 2^r u$ with $u$ odd, and let $s \le r$ and $t \mid u$ be natural numbers such that $g^{2^s t} = 2$ for some primitive root $g$ modulo $p$ (an element of order $p - 1$ in $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$). Let $k$ be the multiplicative order of $2$ modulo $u/t$, with $k = 1$ when $t = u$. Then the sequence $n \mapsto F_{r-s+n} \bmod p$ is periodic with…
nodes.title: Preperiod and period of Fermat residues from the index of $2$

nodes.summary: Write $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$ for the $n$-th Fermat number. Let $m$ be a natural number and let $i \le j$. If $F_j \not\equiv F_{j+t} \pmod{m}$ for every $t \ge 1$, then $F_i \not\equiv F_{i+t} \pmod{m}$ for every $t \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Non-congruence of Fermat numbers passes to smaller indices

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $g$ be a primitive root modulo $p$ (an element of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ of multiplicative order $p - 1$), and let $a \in \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$. If $g^i = a$ for a natural number $i$, then $\gcd(p - 1, i) = (p - 1)/\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$, where $\operatorname{ord}_p(a)$ is the multiplicative order of $a$ modulo $p$.
nodes.title: The index of a residue and its multiplicative order

nodes.summary: A natural number $p$ is a Fermat prime if $p$ is prime and $p = 2^{2^k} + 1$ for some natural number $k$, that is, $p$ is a prime Fermat number.
nodes.title: Fermat prime

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $\operatorname{ord}_p(2)$ be the multiplicative order of $2$ modulo $p$. If $p \equiv 7 \pmod 8$, then $\operatorname{ord}_p(2)$ is odd. If $p \equiv 3 \pmod 8$, then $\operatorname{ord}_p(2)$ is divisible by $2$ but not by $4$. If $p \equiv 5 \pmod 8$, then $\operatorname{ord}_p(2)$ is divisible by $4$ but not by $8$.
nodes.title: The power of $2$ dividing the order of $2$ modulo a prime

nodes.summary: Write $F_n = 2^{2^n} + 1$ for the $n$-th Fermat number. An odd prime $p$ divides $F_n$ if and only if the multiplicative order of $2$ modulo $p$ equals $2^{n+1}$.
nodes.title: Prime divisors of Fermat numbers and the order of $2$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
